Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file a fresh petition challenging the charge sheet.
2. The said submission is placed on record.

3. In view of the aforesaid submission, since charge sheet has already been filed, the present petition stands disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to file a fresh petition challenging the charge sheet and seeking such other appropriate reliefs.
